title: Pool ID of the testnet USD pair given in XDR byte order (issuer keys e305… < f7a4…)
why: stellar-core accepts a constant-product pool only with assetA < assetB in XDR byte order (type, code bytes, then the issuer's raw key); readers that order issuers by their strkey text refuse this valid pair, because the two orders disagree here.
